project_type: OmniRoute: Next.js 16 App Router dashboard + API (src/), streaming engine workspace (open-sse/), npm workspaces
language: TypeScript / TSX (React 19, next-intl, Tailwind, recharts lazy-loaded)
build_system: npm; Next.js standalone build (next.config.mjs sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors, so tsc gates are separate). Repo is /Users/celes/sources/celesrenata/OmniRoute; the agent shell's default cwd is the menagerie workspace, so ALWAYS cd to the repo or use absolute paths.
test_framework: node:test via tsx for pure logic (tests/unit/**/*.test.ts); Vitest + jsdom for components (vitest.config.ts includes tests/unit/**/*.test.tsx and src/app/**/dashboard/cache/__tests__/**/*.test.tsx)
build_command: npm run typecheck:core && npm run check:dashboard-typecheck (no full next build needed locally; the deploy step builds the image on esnixi)
test_command: Focused: node --import tsx/esm --import ./open-sse/utils/setupPolyfill.ts --import ./tests/_setup/isolateDataDir.ts --test <file.test.ts> ; npx vitest run <file.test.tsx>. Full suite `npm run test:unit` pegs the Mac CPU: run it AT MOST ONCE in the whole run (integration step).
verification_instructions: 1) focused node:test / vitest files for the changed modules; 2) npx eslint --suppressions-location config/quality/eslint-suppressions.json <changed files> (0 errors, suppression counts must not increase); 3) npm run typecheck:core; 4) npm run check:dashboard-typecheck (no regression vs config/quality/dashboard-typecheck-baseline.json); 5) npm run check:file-size; 6) npx prettier --check <changed files>; 7) if i18n keys added: npm run i18n:sync-ui then npm run i18n:check-ui-coverage.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/i18n/messages/*.json are updated by `npm run i18n:sync-ui` (adds __MISSING__:<english> markers for keys new in en.json) and must be committed. No other generated files.
